scenes.title: The Morning After the Party
scenes.summary: Fedya teases Denis about kissing Sveta at the party, and Sveta tells Denis she broke up with her boyfriend Misha so she wouldn't have to lie to him.

scenes.title: Meeting with Dyagilev
scenes.summary: Mikhail warns Barinov about Andrey Dyagilev's visit, only to find Dyagilev already in the dining room discussing Nikita and Katya with Eleonora.

scenes.title: The Brother's Arrival and the Nickname Zyuzya
scenes.summary: Barinov's brother Valentin arrives unexpectedly from America and embarrasses the chef by telling the kitchen the story behind his childhood nickname 'Zyuzya.'

scenes.title: Oysters in Russia
scenes.summary: Valya pitches an oyster-farming business to a skeptical Barinov and promises to repay his old loan soon with interest.

scenes.title: The Forgotten Suitcase and Raisins
scenes.summary: Valya claims he left his suitcase in a taxi from the airport, and Lyova interrupts to report that Timur delivered the wrong raisins.

scenes.title: The Bartender's Advice
scenes.summary: Senya hides behind the bar from Barinov while Kostya pours Denis a shot of vodka and advises him to explain everything honestly to Sveta.

scenes.title: Fight in the Courtyard
scenes.summary: Sveta's ex-boyfriend Misha attacks Denis in the courtyard, and Sveta is touched when Denis gets a bruise on her account.

scenes.title: Business Talk with a Rival
scenes.summary: Barinov spots his brother Valya pitching an oyster farm project to Andrey Dyagilev and calls Valya to demand he stop.

scenes.title: The Lost Wallet and an Introduction
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya find Misha's lost wallet with his office pass, and Nikita surprises Katya by introducing her to his father as his girlfriend.

scenes.title: Awkward Introduction and a Cherry Bet
scenes.summary: Katya excuses herself from Nikita's father's table after being called Nikita's girlfriend, then accepts a kitchen bet to catch two thrown cherries.

scenes.title: Dyagilev's Ultimatum
scenes.summary: Unaware that Katya is Eleonora's daughter, Andrey Dyagilev corners her after the cherry game and orders her to break up with Nikita.

scenes.title: Someone Else's Envelope
scenes.summary: Dyagilev finishes warning Katya away from Nikita, and his courier mistakenly hands an envelope of money meant for Valentin to Chef Viktor Barinov.

scenes.title: A Son's Rebellion and a Brother's Prank
scenes.summary: Nastya tells Nikita about his father's threat to Katya, prompting Nikita to stand up to Dyagilev, while Barinov tells Elena he wants to prank his brother.

scenes.title: Ambush Outside the Office
scenes.summary: Denis, Senya, and Fedya tackle Misha outside his office to tell him to get back together with Sveta, only to learn that Sveta is Misha's sister.

scenes.title: Sveta's Exposed Deception
scenes.summary: Misha reveals that Sveta staged the attack because she is infatuated with Denis, and Denis hurries away when Sveta tries to get him to walk her home.

scenes.title: Invitation to a Family Dinner
scenes.summary: Dyagilev apologizes to Nikita and invites him to dinner that evening to meet Eleonora's daughter—unaware that she is Katya.

scenes.title: Preparing a Surprise and the Honest Cabbie
scenes.summary: Katya plans with Eleonora to surprise Dyagilev at dinner as her daughter, while the cab driver returns Valya's forgotten suitcase to Mikhail.

scenes.title: The Truth About the Brother's Business
scenes.summary: Barinov tries to warn Dyagilev against doing business with Valya, only to learn that Valya is a successful American oyster entrepreneur.

scenes.title: A Lesson in Trust
scenes.summary: Barinov confesses to losing the envelope of money in a taxi, and Valya reveals the money was actually his repayment of his old debt to Viktor.

scenes.title: The Hotel Owner's Daughter
scenes.summary: Eleonora introduces Katya to Andrey Dyagilev as her daughter, forcing a humbled Dyagilev to apologize for his earlier threats.
